title: A Conversation with I. J. Good
lineage: Original published interview with Good, hosted by Virginia Tech. Good provides a separate participant’s retrospective account. The Garwin letter is quoted by Good without an original letter facsimile.

passages.note: Good dates a visit by Tukey to Cheltenham to December 1956, during which he says he briefly told Tukey about his FFT. Good says he did not discuss it with Garwin during Garwin’s separate visit in September 1957. He distinguishes the transform relationships used by the two methods.
passages.quote: I told Tukey briefly about my FFT (with very little detail)
